name: contextlean
description: Audit, evaluate, and safely optimize controllable context in local AI agent environments.

interface.shortDescription: Measure, evaluate, and safely optimize Agent context
interface.longDescription: A local-only, reversible Agent context optimizer for rules, Skills, Context Packs, plugins, hooks, and cross-vendor configuration. It measures first, evaluates bounded candidates, applies only hash-guarded reviewed plans, and supports exact rollback.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Agent environment and explain the highest-value evidence-backed optimizations.
Measure this repository, evaluate bounded context candidates, and prepare a reversible plan only for a proven winner.
